title: 1stDibs 2025 Trend Report: Heritage Revival, Cowboy Core, and Y2K Resurgence Drive Luxury E-Commerce Trends
summary: 1stDibs presents the latest data on the site’s consumer-buying trends from the past year 1stDibs , the leading marketplace for extraordinary design, has released its 2025 Luxury E-Commerce Report , drawing on unique data and insights from its global marketplace. The report unveils the defining trends of 1stDibs’ discerning audience across the following core luxury categories: Furniture Lighting, Art, Watches Jewelry, Handbags, and Fashion.
